description:
**Level Up Your Career!**

At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.

At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.

**Join the team!**  

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Lead Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.

We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.

This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* **Understand the games inside out.** Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
* **Start with a hypothesis.** Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
* **Run experiments that decide.** Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
* **Connect growth and product.** Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
* **Grow the product craft.** Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
* **Spot tomorrow’s hits.** Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

### **What You’ll Own:**

Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

**How we’ll celebrate your success:**

* Growth in LTV and profit from product changes
* Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games
* Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped
* Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions

### **What We’re Looking For:**

**Essential**

* Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.
* Strong analytical skills: at home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.
* A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.
* Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads
* A clear, warm communicator who makes the case in players and pounds.

**Desirable**

* SQL experience.
* Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.
* Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience

### **Why Kwalee?**

* **Generous Holiday:** Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* **Flexible Working:** We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* **Health Cover:** Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* **Free Food & Drink:** Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* **Gaming Goodies:** Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* **Transport:** Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* **Office Location:** Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* **Merch & Events:** Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

### **Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**

At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.

Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.

We recognise the importance of self-development, career progression, and well-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Commercial Product Manager
description:
**Commercial Product Manager**

**Would you like to build products to delight our customers?**

**Can you use a data-driven approach to uncover information and opportunities?**

**About our Team**
------------------

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Commercial Product Manager will own one or more product/solution and lead commercial rollout and product lifecycle in-market. He/she will own product development plans and represent their feature(s) within the cross-functional team proposing new feature ideas that address a customer pain point or need based on his/her deep and first hand understanding of the customer. He/she will prioritize and communicate customer issues based on relevant data for timely resolution and also lead the demo/product showcase to key stakeholders at program milestones. The Product Manager is key person involved in Go To Market strategy and execution, working alongside Sales and Marketing driving business growth.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts frequently with customers, and generates customer requirements.
* Anticipates customer needs and prioritizes those for the organization.
* Understands how his/her role impacts customer satisfaction.
* Analyzes and interprets what is happening in the market, driven by the latest news and trends, particularly competitive announcements and events.
* Predicts short term market changes and implications on the product.
* Continuously aims to meet customer expectations without compromising commercial viability and quality of the product.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Actively gathers data from multiple sources (customer, market analysis, sales and revenue, etc.) to drive solutions to business problems and issues of consequence to the company.
* Demonstrates the ability to make trade off decisions between potential product capabilities.
* Evaluates product hypotheses in a quantitative manner, including AB testing for interactive products.
* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.
* Generates new ideas by analyzing product data for insights.

**Go to Market & Product Marketing Lifecycle**

* Supports the go to market strategy with good communication of customer requirements and timelines to stakeholders
* Assists on product rollout launch plans through coordinated development with external customer facing teams such as marketing and sales.
* Answers sales and customer questions regarding feature function, pricing, packaging, value proposition and competition.
* Offers enablement sessions and provide materials in support of operations for market rollout, for Sales and customer facing teams
* Outlines key milestones, outcomes and deliverables during go-to-market and product strategy planning.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Solves customer issues with product and content aligned with business goals
* Has a deep understanding of product features, value proposition, customer Use Cases; able to develop User story, prototypes and test hypotheses
* Lead product discovery, according to defined process, for new product and feature development.
* Manages end to end product lifecycle, provide periodic review and analysis of product performance, and recommendation for investment and divestment

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Determines strategic product vision and priorities for a feature area, and shapes/champions future product direction.
* Independently uses information derived from competitive analysis to drive product direction and strategy.
* Understands, formulates and budgets the operating costs required to deliver the revenues
* Creates product development plans including opportunity assessment and business case.

**Technical Skills**

* Considers high-level technical approaches to use when prioritizing functionality.
* Is proficient with technologies and AI
* Has a firm grasp of data, technical principles and best practices of product management

**Requirements**
----------------

* Show a customer-centric focus when creating solutions
* Minimum Years of PM Experience: 4 years
* Able to collaborate with cross-functional teams to create, and rollout successful products to customers
* Have great experience working as a Product Lead, delivering enhancements and innovation to customers contributing to business growth
* Have excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex information to a variety of audiences
* Have a proficient background in various technologies including Microsoft suites, Power BI, data analytics tools and AI tools
* Bachelors degree in commercial discipline ( Product, Marketing, Business, Law). MBA is preferred.

**Work in a way that works for you**
------------------------------------

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

* Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

**Working for you**
-------------------

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.

* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.

* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.

* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.

* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance.

* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges.

* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.

* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.

* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.

* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.

* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.

**About the Business**
----------------------

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Join the Books org and lead product development for our Payment and Purchase Experience charter. We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Technical to help create the most trusted and delightful end-to-end purchase and payments CX for Books customers world-wide. You will develop the strategy and vision for this charter and collaborate with an engineering team to oversee the development of related products and features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The ideal candidate is highly analytical, demonstrates strong judgment, can work effectively across a matrix organization, and has a proven history of creating delightful customer experiences and delivering results. Experience in the payments and ordering space is a plus.  
  
A day in the life  

* Product Vision and Ownership: End-to-end accountability; leads strategy, value proposition, game-changing ideas, evolution. Focuses on customer delight. Ensures we're focused on the right metrics for the business.
* Customer: What problem are we solving? How can we add more value for customers? Where can we invent?
* Product Development/Roadmap: Defines functional, user experience, legal and other business requirements. Manages feature prioritization; helps engineering, operations, and creative make the right CX trade-offs.
* Compliance headwinds: Adeptly navigates urgent compliance requirements, defines goals, and brings them to fruition through collaboration with tech, legal, and local partners.

  
About the team  
The mission of the Books Customer Value org is to maximize customers’ return on money, time, and energy spent acquiring Books and empower them to read more. We do so by obsessing over value to ensure sharp pricing, making acquiring a book seamless and secure, and providing tools to build a reading habit.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

description:
**Job Description**

NIQ Activate is a single platform bringing together powerful retail capabilities — insights, analytics, and supplier collaboration tools. As we evolve our Promotion Effectiveness and Planning modules, we are looking for a Senior Product Manager to enable data-driven promotion strategy, optimization, and performance measurement.

**Key responsibilities**

* Product Requirements & Prioritization: Create and maintain a well‑defined, prioritized product backlog aligned with business and product objectives.
* PI Planning and Execution: Coordinate delivery through PI planning, execution, and review cycles to ensure alignment and timely delivery.
* Collaboration with Data Science: Partner with data science to identify models, validate outputs, and ensure analytical robustness.
* Technical Collaboration & Architecture Alignment: Work closely with Engineering to ensure scalable, efficient, and feasible solutions aligned to platform architecture.
* Market Research and Analysis: Leverage market trends, competitive insights, and customer needs to inform roadmap and prioritization.
* User Experience: Collaborate with UX to design intuitive workflows and ensure clear product documentation (Figma, acceptance criteria).
* Product Advocacy & Enablement: Support commercial teams and translate analytical outputs into clear business value.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Lead a cross-functional product pod, driving alignment across Engineering, Data Science, UX, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Own end-to-end delivery of product initiatives, proactively managing risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and execution progress.
* Partner with Engineering leadership to support capacity planning, release readiness, and successful product delivery.
* Own roadmap for promotion planning, forecasting, optimization, scenario planning, and post-event effectiveness measurement.
* Define capabilities for uplift modeling, cannibalization analysis, promotion optimization, and scenario simulation.
* Drive development of planning workflows and decision-support tools for pricing and promotions.
* Ensure alignment with category management and revenue management processes.
* Continuously improve models based on real-world performance and feedback loops.
* Define and track product, adoption, operational, and business KPIs to continuously improve product performance, customer value realization, and revenue outcomes.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

### **The Role**

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for aSenior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

### **What You'll Do**

### **Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy**

* Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
* Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
* Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.

### **Build Data-Driven Fraud Products**

* Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
* Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
* Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
* Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
* Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.

### **Lead Product Execution**

* Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
* Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
* Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
* Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
* Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

### **Manage Fraud & Risk Events**

* Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
* Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
* Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.

### **Collaborate Across Tala**

* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
* Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
* Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.

### **What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.
* Proven experience building or managing products related to fraud, risk, authentication, identity, KYC, account security, payments, lending, or financial crime.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science to build fraud detection, risk decisioning, authentication, or identity solutions.
* Experience using data and metrics to make product decisions and measure outcomes.
* Experience managing fraud incidents, emerging fraud patterns, or other high-impact risk events.
* Ability to translate complex and ambiguous problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
* Experience managing external vendors or technology partners.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced, distributed, and highly collaborative environment.

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. As the Technical Product Owner you will need to be technically strong and product-minded as you will be leading the development and evolution of our Content Sourcing Systems!

You will be responsible for defining platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient collection of all non-realtime data for LSEG Data and Analytics.

You’ll be joining our Data Platforms Sourcing Engineering team as a Senior Technical Product Owner. This team’s products are the tools used by Content Operations and Data Scientists to find, retrieve, check, validate and transform all the data behind LSEG’s provision of financial market data to over 40,000 customers.

You will work with customers across LSEG to define new tools and capabilities that consolidate, modernise and grow D&A’s data collection.

By building trust with partners, managing expectations transparently, and ensuring alignment across teams, you will build solutions that provide measurable business value. Success will be measured not only by delivery, but also by adoption, customer satisfaction, and time-to-value.

  

**Key responsibilities will include:**

* Defining, prioritizing, and delivering desirable, feasible, viable, and secure Sourcing products.

* Creating the product vision/roadmap, managing the program backlog, identifying customer needs, and aligning ART efforts with business strategy.

* Articulating the roadmap, value decisions and trade-offs, and priorities to customers across the organisation, including senior leaders and non-technical staff.

* Drive PI planning to ensure teams are aligned on outcomes, dependencies and integration

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**

**Platform Ownership:** Own and evolve the product vision, roadmap, and strategy for Sourcing Engineering and its core capabilities, acting as the interface between the business stakeholders and development teams.

**Product Backlog & Outcome:** Own and communicate a product backlog of epics and features, leading trade-off decisions to balance customer needs, architectural integrity, and business value.

**Capability Development:** Define and deliver new platform features to support self-service teams to meet their goals of agility and flexibility in the creation and delivery of data products.

**Strategic Road mapping:** Collaborate with engineering, operations and data strategy leadership to shape the long-term platform strategy based on customer insights, emerging technologies, and enterprise needs.

**Modern Product Practices:** Together with System Architect and Release Train Engineer, lead large-scale agile delivery (SAFe), manage cross-team coordination, and ensure transparency across stakeholders.

**Developer Enablement:** Champion design thinking and user journey clarity to ensure features address real user needs; attend demos and provide approval when deliverables meet business needs.

**Agile Ceremony Cadence:** Drive ART readiness for PI Planning by coordinating across interested parties including, Product Owners, technology, and Business Owners to align scope and objectives.

**Cross ART Collaboration:** Work with other ARTs to set product goals and roadmap; promote shared accountability across functions & streams and proactively calling out blockers & risks to ensure a “no-surprises” environment.

**Innovation, Security & Compliance:** Champion new technologies and processes, balanced against the need to maintain rigorous security controls, and compliance with applicable regulations and laws.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* 15+ years of professional experience in product management, product ownership, and data or platform engineering or a related field.

* Proven ability to communicate succinctly with functional teams, partners of all levels and leadership.

* Product ownership experience working with Scrum teams, attending scrum ceremonies, owning the scrum team backlog.

* Ability to elicit requirements from customers and articulate them as hierarchical user story format (Epics, Features, Stories).

* Financial services experience; knowledge of data used within financial services.

* Experience of Agile methodologies, ideally with a certification (SAFe or similar).

* Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM education.

* Preferred Skills

* Hands-On JIRA and Confluence proficiency, familiarity with agile reporting dashboards.

* Knowledge and experience with end-to-end processes of data collection, processing, and distribution, including understanding of data operations/content operations workflows.

* Exposure to technology platforms, architecture principles, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Experience with value stream mapping, process improvement, and user journey design.

* Strong analytical approach with a focus on measurable outcomes and business value

  

**What you’ll get in return**

**High-impact projects:** We work on a variety of pioneering AI products and leverage extensive datasets to solve complex, high-value challenges.

**Competitive benefits:** You will enjoy a strong compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing investment in career growth and skill development.

**Industry leadership:** This is an opportunity to be a founding member of the organization that’s delivering brand-new products that democratize modeling and analytics solutions.

**Collaborative environment** : We provide opportunities for continuous learning and professional development in a work environment of dedicated, highly experienced teams.

  

We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take a hybrid approach to the workplace; this role is considered ‘digital first’, which requires attending the office at least one day per week while some teams and colleagues choose to collaborate in the office more frequently.
  
  
You will experience the critical role we have in helping to re-engineer the financial ecosystem to support and drive sustainable economic growth. Together, we are aiming to achieve this growth by accelerating the just transition to net zero, enabling growth of the green economy and creating inclusive economic opportunity.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Make your mark by leading a high-visibility modernization that reshapes how teams access trusted insights at scale. You will drive a firmwide legacy analytics decommission and migration, partnering with senior leaders and global delivery teams to deliver measurable outcomes by a strategic deadline. Join a team that values ownership, career mobility, and hands-on impact across a complex technology transformation.

As a Product Manager at JPMorganChase within Commercial & Investment Banking unit, you will lead end-to-end delivery of a legacy business intelligence platform decommission and migration to modern cloud-native analytics tools. You will own inventory analysis, migration planning, and cross-functional execution to move thousands of reports, schedules, and users to approved replacement capabilities. You will partner with technology, data, and business stakeholders to prioritize migration waves, reduce scope through rationalization, and ensure continuity for critical reporting. You will provide transparent governance and executive communications to ensure delivery against a firm strategic deadline.

This role sits within a senior leadership-sponsored transformation program and focuses on retiring legacy reporting capabilities while enabling scalable, modern analytics. You will coordinate across multiple geographies and functions to align business priorities, data dependencies, and delivery sequencing. Success in this role requires strong product ownership, structured program governance, and the ability to translate complex reporting and data flows into actionable migration plans. You will balance speed of delivery with risk awareness, ensuring that regulated or controlled reporting obligations remain continuously supported.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously improve a comprehensive inventory of reports, schedules, and data extract processes, driving rationalization and recertification to reduce migration scope and risk.
* Map report logic and data flows to business processes, application integrations, and downstream dependencies, prioritizing migration waves based on criticality and complexity.
* Lead stakeholder engagement across business and technology functions, facilitating workshops to document current usage, capture requirements, and define future-state reporting needs.
* Define functional and non-functional requirements for replacement reporting capabilities, including scheduling, distribution, embedded analytics, and integration needs.
* Drive evaluation and selection of replacement tools by coordinating structured demos, proof-of-concept activities, and decision forums aligned to program objectives and constraints.
* Oversee migration planning and execution across data warehouse, data pipelines (extract, transform, load), and reporting layers, ensuring source-to-target mapping and semantic definitions are maintained.
* Leverage analytics and approved automation approaches (including responsible use of artificial intelligence-enabled tooling) to accelerate usage analysis, pattern detection, and migration prioritization while maintaining appropriate risk awareness.
* Produce clear program governance artifacts (status reporting, risks/issues/dependencies, milestone tracking, and escalation materials) for senior technology and business leadership.
* Coordinate cross-functional delivery across a global team, proactively surfacing blockers, managing competing priorities, and driving timely decisions.
* Deliver change management activities including user communications, training coordination for new platforms, adoption tracking, and transition support through cutover.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Proven experience as a technical product manager or senior business analyst delivering large-scale technology decommission, data migration, or reporting transformation programs in financial services.
* Demonstrated knowledge of enterprise reporting landscapes, including report lifecycle management, self-service reporting, automated scheduling/distribution, embedded analytics, and integration with data pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise reporting or analytics platform (for example: Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Microsoft Power BI, MicroStrategy, Sigma, Cognos, SAP BusinessObjects, or similar).
* Experience analyzing, rationalizing, and migrating large report inventories, including prioritization, wave planning, and execution tracking.
* Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts (for example: dimensional modeling, facts and dimensions, and data marts) sufficient to assess migration impacts and dependencies.
* Working knowledge of data integration patterns and pipeline scheduling sufficient to document data flows and coordinate re-platforming activities with engineering teams.
* Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL), including complex joins and reconciliations used to validate migration completeness and data quality.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience facilitating workshops, aligning cross-functional priorities, and driving decisions across senior audiences.
* Program governance capability, including structured planning, milestone management, dependency management, and executive-ready communications.
* Awareness of regulated, controlled, or audit-relevant reporting considerations and the need to maintain continuity during platform transitions.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Hands-on experience with SAP BusinessObjects and/or Crystal Reports (for example: Web Intelligence, scheduling, universe design, or report development).
* Experience building dashboards or reports in modern analytics tools (for example: calculations, parameters, filters, and visualization best practices).
* Experience using analytics automation or artificial intelligence-enabled tools (e.g. Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex, ChatGPT/Copilot) to accelerate dataset analysis or workflow efficiency in a controlled enterprise environment.
* Experience with cloud-native data platforms (for example: Snowflake, Databricks, or Google BigQuery) and how reporting tools connect to cloud query engines.
* Experience with SQL performance tuning, data profiling, anomaly detection, and end-to-end data quality validation.
* Experience coordinating user acceptance testing across distributed user groups and supporting structured change management.
* Experience engaging vendors and running structured evaluations, proofs of concept, or request-for-information/request-for-proposal processes.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Senior Product Manager, Orders & Reservations**

**About the Team**  
Orders & Reservations sits at the center of Expedia Group's commerce platform — the system of record for every booking and the servicing backbone from purchase through cancellation, change, or refund. The platform supports global B2C travelers, B2B partners, and internal finance and analytics consumers across every line of business and brand.
  
  
**What You Will Do (Roles & Responsibilities)**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will help improve the Book-to-Serve journey by optimizing purchase, booking, and payment success while reducing Failed Customer Interactions through better validation, orchestration, retry, guidance, and intelligent routing. Specifically, you will:

  

* Own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for order management and reservations, translating business and technical goals into measurable outcomes for a highly scalable, business-critical platform
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design and evolve APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-based integrations that improve orchestration, retry logic, and intelligent routing across the transaction lifecycle
* Drive down Failed Customer Interactions by leading incident learnings, root-cause analysis, defect reduction, and monitoring/alerting improvements in partnership with operations and support teams
* Lead cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, analytics, finance, and risk — writing clear PRDs, prioritization frameworks, and delivery plans, and building alignment through executive updates and trade-off discussions
* Explore and apply AI/ML, LLMs, and intelligent automation (e.g., anomaly detection, synthetic monitoring, agent-assisted operations) to proactively catch and prevent booking, payment, and servicing failures
Use data, dashboards, and experimentation to continuously track purchase, booking, and payment success rates, identifying friction points across the Shop-to-Book-to-Serve journey and prioritizing fixes accordingly  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Min 7+ years of product management experience owning complex, platform-oriented products across booking, orders, reservations, payments, servicing, or transaction lifecycle
* Strong understanding of commerce/booking journeys — supply, payment authorization, fraud, confirmation, cancellations, refunds, and post-booking servicing
* Proven ability to define product vision, strategy, and roadmaps that drive measurable improvements in success, reliability, and cost metrics for large-scale systems
* Strong technical fluency (APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, cloud architectures) and ability to partner effectively with engineering
* Demonstrated cross-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills, including executive updates and influence without direct authority
Strong analytical rigor — using data, experimentation, and root-cause analysis to guide decisions and reduce Failed Customer Interactions  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience with order management systems, reservation platforms, travel/hospitality commerce, marketplaces, or other high-volume transactional products
* Familiarity with booking and servicing metrics — Purchase Success Rate, Booking Success Rate, Payment Success Rate, authorization success, cancellation rates, refund completion, contact/failure rates
* Experience integrating with suppliers, payment providers, fraud systems, customer-support tools, finance platforms, or external B2B partners
* Experience building or scaling self-service servicing capabilities for cancellations, changes, refunds, and trip management
* Experience driving platform cost optimization, telemetry efficiency, cloud economics, or governance programs
* Software engineering, systems architecture, or computer science background, with ability to engage deeply in technical design discussions
* Experience operating products globally across multiple brands, lines of business, markets, currencies, regulatory environments, or customer segments
* MBA or equivalent business education; technical degree or equivalent technical experience

* Identify gaps and usability problems; recommend practical improvements.

* Run brief progress reviews, track blockers, and verify completed work.

We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data-driven and analytic decision making and making customer-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. **Position Overview**  
  
The **Senior Product Owner** is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.  
  
This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding & Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player-manager who both delivers and develops.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

  

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

  

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

  

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day-to-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

  

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Team Development**

  

* In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
* As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role)**  
  
Depending on the specific Product Owner role, candidates should bring deep expertise in one or more of the following clusters:

  

* Core HCM, Onboarding & Workday Help: Org design, job architecture, business process configuration, worker data, Workday Help case management.
* Compensation & Advanced Compensation: Salary structures, merit and bonus plans, compensation cycles, equity, allowances, and global pay practices.
* Recruiting, Paradox & HiredScore: Recruiting business processes, offer management, candidate experience, AI screening tools, and sourcing integrations.
* Talent & Learning: Performance reviews, goal management, succession planning, learning campaigns, content management, and skills framework.
* US Benefits & US Payroll: Open enrollment, benefit plans, ACA compliance, payroll processing, tax configuration, and off-cycle runs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

---------------

Glomo is the regulated infrastructure layer that financial platforms build on for cross-border money movement out of India. We hold the licences, the bank integrations, the compliance engine and the settlement rails, and run them behind our clients' own brands.

Brokers, wealth platforms, AMCs, exporters and other businesses use Glomo to onboard their customers, run KYC and compliance checks, move and settle funds across borders, and reconcile it all back into their own systems. Our products span LRS remittances, global investing, card issuance and treasury.

Glomo is regulated by IFSCA through its GIFT City entity. Compliance is part of the product, and every PM here treats it that way.

**The role**
------------

We are hiring an Associate Product Manager / Product Manager, reporting directly to the founders. Level depends on experience.

This is a business product role. At Glomo, PMs sell: you will be in the room with merchants from the first conversation, and you will be accountable for the deal as much as the spec. You are not a feature desk for the sales team. You understand the customer well enough to decide what we should build for them, and what we should not.

You will join sales calls and demos, bring what you learn back to the product team, help shape the roadmap with them, write specs for the features you own, ship them with engineering, and take merchants live.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Sell.** Run discovery and demos, map a merchant's needs onto Glomo's products, and work with sales to close.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Bring merchant feedback and market insight to the product team, and work with them to prioritise what we build.
* **Write and ship.** Turn merchant needs into clear PRDs and user flows for the features you own. Work with engineering and design through launch.
* **Take merchants live.** Drive integration and onboarding, and unblock issues across ops, compliance and the merchant's own team.
* **Track adoption.** Watch usage and conversion, find where users drop off, and fix it.
* **Work inside the rules.** Partner with compliance, legal and risk so products meet IFSCA and FEMA/LRS requirements from day one.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2+ years of work experience, including a client-facing sales role: account executive, inside sales, pre-sales or enterprise BD, preferably selling software or tech.
* MBA from a premier Indian business school.
* You can run a discovery call and a demo, handle objections, and manage a client relationship.
* Structured thinking and clear writing. You can turn a messy customer problem into a simple spec.
* Comfortable with data: Excel, and ideally basic SQL, to read a funnel and size an opportunity.
* You use AI tools effectively in your day-to-day work, for research, analysis, writing specs and prototyping, and you know where they fall short.
* Curious about how technical products work, and able to hold a conversation with engineers about APIs and integrations.
* You move fast, take ownership, and follow through without being chased.

**Good to have**
----------------

* Experience in financial services: banking, payments, fintech, broking, wealth management or mutual funds.
* Exposure to cross-border payments, or working knowledge of LRS, FEMA or KYC/AML.
* A product internship or prior product stint.
* Early-stage startup experience.
* An engineering undergraduate degree.

**Why Glomo**
-------------

* Work directly with the founders on a small team.
* Own real merchant relationships and real product outcomes from your first month.
* Build regulated cross-border infrastructure that brokers, AMCs and payment platforms run on.

Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.

We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.

To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

**Product Manager – CPaaS**

**Company:** Hawk Martech  
**Location:** Gurugram – DLF Corporate Greens  
**Work Mode:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Department:** Product & Technology

**About the Role**

Hawk Martech is looking for an experienced **Product Manager – CPaaS** to drive the development and growth of communication and customer-engagement products.

The ideal candidate should have **hands-on product management experience in CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service)** and a strong understanding of communication channels such as **SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voice, Email, and communication APIs**.

We are specifically looking for someone who has worked with **CPaaS, communication platforms, messaging platforms, cloud telephony, conversational communication, or API-based communication products** and understands the technical and commercial aspects of these products.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the **product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution** for CPaaS and communication products.
* Identify market opportunities and customer problems across messaging, voice, and communication channels.
* Define product priorities based on customer requirements, market trends, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
* Work closely with leadership to define product growth and expansion strategies.
* Manage the complete product lifecycle from **discovery to development, launch, and optimization**.

CPaaS Product Management

* Drive products and features across **SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voice, Email, and other communication channels**.
* Understand communication APIs, messaging workflows, delivery mechanisms, templates, routing, authentication, and third-party integrations.
* Work on **omnichannel communication and customer engagement** use cases.
* Understand and manage integrations with telecom operators, messaging providers, communication platforms, and other third-party APIs.
* Identify opportunities to improve message delivery, reliability, scalability, customer experience, and platform adoption.
* Work with technical teams on APIs, webhooks, SDKs, integrations, dashboards, reporting, and automation workflows.

Product Discovery & Market Research

* Conduct customer interviews and gather requirements from enterprise customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Research competitors and market developments across the **CPaaS, messaging, cloud communication, and customer engagement** ecosystem.
* Analyze platforms and solutions offered by companies such as **Tanla Platforms, Route Mobile, Gupshup, Exotel, Tata Communications, Airtel IQ, Netcore, Twilio, Plivo, Sinch, Infobip, Bird, Vonage, and similar communication platforms**.
* Identify gaps in existing solutions and convert them into actionable product opportunities.
* Stay updated with developments in **WhatsApp Business, RCS, SMS, Voice APIs, cloud telephony, conversational AI, and communication technology**.

Product Development

* Create detailed **PRDs, user stories, product specifications, workflows, and acceptance criteria**.
* Work closely with engineering, UI/UX, QA, DevOps, and business teams.
* Translate customer and business requirements into clear technical and functional requirements.
* Prioritize features and manage scope, dependencies, timelines, and releases.
* Participate in product testing, UAT, release planning, and post-launch reviews.
* Ensure products are scalable, reliable, secure, and easy to use.

API & Technical Product Management

* Work closely with engineering teams on **REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, third-party integrations, and event-driven workflows**.
* Understand API documentation, authentication, request/response structures, error handling, and integration dependencies.
* Work with technical teams to define API requirements and integration experiences.
* Ensure seamless integration between CPaaS products and customer systems such as **CRM, marketing automation, e-commerce, and customer-support platforms**.
* A strong understanding of technical architecture and API-based products is required.

Compliance & Telecom Ecosystem

* Stay updated with relevant communication and messaging regulations, policies, and industry requirements.
* Understand areas such as **DLT, TRAI regulations, sender IDs, templates, consent, messaging policies, and delivery compliance**.
* Track changes in WhatsApp Business policies, RCS ecosystem developments, telecom requirements, and other platform policies.
* Work with technical and business teams to ensure product changes are aligned with applicable requirements.

Analytics & Product Performance

* Define and monitor key product and business metrics.
* Track metrics such as:
* Message Delivery Rate
* Delivery Success Rate
* API Usage
* Message Volume
* Customer Activation
* Customer Retention
* Conversion Rate
* Revenue
* Usage & Adoption
* Cost per Message / Communication
* Use product analytics and customer data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Work with engineering teams to ensure appropriate product tracking and analytics are implemented.

Pricing & Commercial Strategy

* Work with leadership on **pricing, plans, usage-based pricing, channel pricing, and packaging**.
* Understand the commercial model of CPaaS products, including communication costs, vendor costs, margins, and usage-based billing.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and increasing product adoption.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **3–6 years of Product Management experience.**
* **Mandatory: Prior experience working on a CPaaS / Communication Platform / Messaging Platform / Cloud Communication product.**
* Strong understanding of **SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voice, Email, and communication APIs**.
* Experience with **B2B SaaS or API-driven products**.
* Strong understanding of **REST APIs, webhooks, third-party integrations, and SDKs**.
* Experience working with engineering and technical teams on API-based products.
* Understanding of **telecom, messaging, cloud telephony, or communication technology**.
* Strong product documentation skills, including **PRDs, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria**.
* Good understanding of product analytics and data-driven decision-making.
* Strong customer discovery and requirement-gathering skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be highly relevant:

* CPaaS
* SMS & Messaging Platforms
* WhatsApp Business API
* RCS
* Voice APIs
* Cloud Telephony
* Contact Center / CCaaS
* IVR
* SIP
* Omnichannel Communication
* Communication APIs
* Customer Engagement Platforms
* Conversational AI
* Marketing Automation
* CRM Integrations
* B2B SaaS

Experience with **Voice AI, LLMs, conversational AI, or AI-powered communication products** will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is someone who has **already worked on a CPaaS or communication technology product**, rather than someone coming purely from a generic SaaS or consumer-app background.

They should understand both sides of the role:

**Business:** customer requirements, pricing, usage, revenue, adoption, and market opportunities.

**Technology:** APIs, integrations, messaging infrastructure, communication channels, workflows, scalability, and technical dependencies.

The candidate should be capable of taking a communication-product requirement from **customer discovery → product strategy → PRD → engineering execution → launch → analytics → continuous improvement**.

Why Join Hawk Martech?

* Opportunity to work on products at the intersection of **Communication, Technology, Digital Marketing, and AI**.
* High ownership across product strategy and execution.
* Opportunity to work closely with engineering, marketing, business, and leadership teams.
* Exposure to enterprise communication and customer-engagement use cases.
* Fast-paced environment with significant opportunities for learning and growth.

**Work Location:** DLF Corporate Greens, Gurugram  
**Work Mode:** On-Site  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
